title: Bonk Brawl
tagline: Dodgeball free-for-all on a floating picnic island.
description: Four goofy animals, one floating island, and a pile of balls. Charge a throw, lead your target, and BONK your friends off the edge. Time a right-click perfectly to catch a throw and turn it around on the thrower. Last animal standing takes the round.
howToPlay: Walk over a ball to pick it up.
Hold left-click to charge, release to throw. Lead moving targets: balls fly in an arc.
Right-click just as a ball reaches you to catch it. The thrower loses a heart.
Three hits or a fall off the island and you're out. Last one standing wins the round.
Most points after 5 rounds wins the match.

controls.action: Hold to charge, release to throw
